descriptions.collections_cloud-create: Create a named scene collection in Excalidraw Plus. Optional: name (string). Returns the new collection's id and metadata. Collections are containers that group multiple scenes; create a collection first, then add scenes to it with collections scenes add.
descriptions.collections_cloud-delete: Permanently delete a scene collection from Excalidraw Plus. Required: collectionId (path). Destructive — removes the collection grouping but does not delete the scenes themselves. Cannot be undone.
descriptions.collections_cloud-get: Fetch metadata for a single collection by ID. Required: collectionId (path). Returns collection name, id, and associated scene count. Use this when you already have the collectionId; use collections list to find IDs.
descriptions.collections_cloud-list: List all scene collections in your Excalidraw Plus workspace. Returns an array of collections with id and name. Use this to discover collectionIds for subsequent get, update, or delete operations.
descriptions.collections_scenes_cloud-collections-add: Add an existing scene to a collection. Required: collectionId (path). Optional: sceneId (body). Returns updated collection membership. The scene must already exist — create it first with scenes create.
descriptions.collections_scenes_cloud-collections-lis: List all scenes that belong to a specific collection. Required: collectionId (path). Returns array of scenes with id, name, and metadata. Use to audit collection membership or find sceneIds for content operations.
descriptions.elements_delete: Remove a single element from the Excalidraw canvas by ID. Required: id (path). Destructive and immediate — save a snapshot first with snapshots create if you may need to restore. Returns 204 on success.
descriptions.elements_get: Retrieve the properties of a single canvas element by ID. Required: id (path). Returns full element object including type, position (x, y), dimensions (width, height), style properties, and groupIds. Use elements list to find IDs.
descriptions.elements_list: Return all elements currently on the Excalidraw canvas served at http://127.0.0.1:3000. No required parameters. Returns array of element objects with type, id, position, dimensions, and style. Use elements search to filter by type or bounding box.
descriptions.excalidraw-canvas-cloud-sync_server-stat: Check sync status and memory usage of the running canvas server. No required parameters. Returns connection state, element count in memory, and WebSocket client count. Use to verify the server is healthy before bulk operations.
descriptions.files_delete: Permanently delete an image file from the canvas by ID. Required: id (path). Destructive — removes the file from the server; any canvas element referencing it will show a broken image. Returns 204 on success.
descriptions.files_list: List all image files currently uploaded to the Excalidraw canvas server. No required parameters. Returns array of file objects with id, name, and mime type. Use to find fileIds before referencing them in element creates.
descriptions.files_upload: Upload one or more image files to the Excalidraw canvas server so they can be referenced by canvas elements. No required query params. Returns the uploaded file id(s). Accepts multipart form data.
descriptions.invites_cloud-create: Send a workspace invitation to a new collaborator in Excalidraw Plus. Optional: email (string), role (string, e.g. member or admin). Returns the new invite id and status. Use invites list to confirm delivery.
descriptions.invites_cloud-delete: Cancel a pending workspace invitation. Required: inviteId (path). Destructive — the invitee can no longer accept the invite after deletion. Returns 204 on success.
descriptions.invites_cloud-list: List all pending (not yet accepted) workspace invitations. No required parameters. Returns array of invite objects with id, email, role, and created date. Use inviteId from this list to cancel specific invites.
descriptions.logs_cloud-workspace: Retrieve workspace audit logs from Excalidraw Plus. Optional: limit (integer), offset (integer) for pagination. Returns an array of log entries with actor, action, timestamp, and target resource. Useful for security auditing and debugging permission changes.
descriptions.scenes_cloud-create: Create a new cloud scene in Excalidraw Plus. Optional: name (string), description (string). Returns the new scene's id, name, and creation time. After creating, push content with scenes content replace.
descriptions.scenes_cloud-delete: Permanently delete a cloud scene and all its content from Excalidraw Plus. Required: sceneId (path). Destructive and irreversible. Does not remove the scene from collections — remove it first with collections scenes list/delete if needed.
descriptions.scenes_cloud-get: Fetch metadata for a single cloud scene by ID. Required: sceneId (path). Returns scene name, description, id, and creation/update timestamps. Does not return element content — use scenes content get for the full Excalidraw JSON.
descriptions.scenes_content_cloud-scenes-update: Merge-update scene content by patching existing elements with the provided Excalidraw JSON fragment. Required: sceneId (path). Preserves elements not included in the patch. Use scenes content replace when you want a full overwrite instead.
descriptions.snapshots_get: Retrieve a named canvas snapshot including all saved element data. Required: name (path, the snapshot name given at creation). Returns the full Excalidraw element array at the time of capture. Use diff to compare two snapshots.
descriptions.workspace_cloud-get: Fetch metadata for the authenticated Excalidraw Plus workspace. No required parameters. Returns workspace name, id, plan, member count, and storage usage. Useful for confirming auth context before workspace-scoped operations.
descriptions.workspace_cloud-list-users: List all members of the authenticated Excalidraw Plus workspace. No required parameters. Returns array of user objects with id, email, name, and role. Use the userId from this list to remove specific members.
